realm_description: The high, thin-aired peaks where thought is clearest. Those drawn here chase vision, discovery, and the kind of knowledge that only comes from climbing higher than everyone else.

primary.label: Inventor
primary.description: Curiosity-led; comfortable deciding by experiment rather than certainty.
primary.guiding_promise: I will find a new way where the old ways have run out.
primary.shadow_description: Abandons every idea the moment a shinier one appears, and finishes nothing.

secondary.label: Strategist
secondary.description: Plays the long game; every move is calculated toward winning.
secondary.guiding_promise: Every move I make today is setting up tomorrow's victory.
secondary.shadow_description: Starts treating the people around them as pieces to be played, not ends in themselves.

wheel.central_question: Should we create the new, or perfect the existing?

growth.label: Strategist
growth.description: Plays the long game; every move is calculated toward winning.
growth.guiding_promise: Every move I make today is setting up tomorrow's victory.
growth.shadow_description: Starts treating the people around them as pieces to be played, not ends in themselves.

other_ally.label: Technocrat
other_ally.description: Optimises for efficiency; people-politics is noise to filter out.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I solve what others accept — with data, not drama.
other_ally.shadow_description: Optimizes the system so completely that the people inside it become variables, not lives.

quarter.label: Farmer
quarter.description: Understands greatness is built on unglamorous, repeated care; trusts slow effort over sudden force.
quarter.guiding_promise: I will tend what grows slowly, trusting the harvest will come.
quarter.shadow_description: Mistakes 'give it time' for permission to never intervene, even as something dies.

opposite.label: Artisan
opposite.description: Pursues mastery and craft; decisions come from trained instinct.
opposite.guiding_promise: I will give every task the full weight of my ability.
opposite.shadow_description: Refuses to call the work finished, and refuses anyone else's hands on it either.

realmmate.label: Visionary
realmmate.description: Sees the shape of what doesn't exist yet; sketches futures vivid enough to pull the world forward.
realmmate.guiding_promise: I will keep dreaming even when the world insists on staying as it is.
realmmate.shadow_description: Gets so lost sketching tomorrow that today is left to fend for itself.

wheel.compatible_text: Visionary · Oracle — fellow travelers of The Mountain Belt.
